entries.heading: None of the funds made available by this Act may be used
ancestors: DIVISION A—-AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2014
entries.text:
Sec. 737.  None of the funds made available by this Act may be used 
to reclassify any area eligible for rural housing programs of the Rural 
Housing Service on September 30, 2013 as not eligible for such programs.

entries.heading: None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made
ancestors: DIVISION E—FINANCIAL SERVICES AND GENERAL GOVERNMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2014
entries.text:
Sec. 737.  None of the funds appropriated or otherwise made 
available by this or any other Act may be used to begin or announce a 
study or public-private competition regarding the conversion to 
contractor performance of any function performed by Federal employees 
pursuant to Office of Management and Budget Circular A-76 or any other 
administrative regulation, directive, or policy.
